mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can impair sertraline metabolism and increase risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and ECG closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider lipid formulation of amphotericin B; adjust sertraline dosing if renal impairment develops.
